locationRef.en: A park bench near the duck pond on a Sunday afternoon. Nobody else nearby.
locationRef.zh: 周日下午，公园的鸭池旁一张长椅。附近没有其他人。

storyPlot.en: You and Sam used to be close platonic friends — the kind of mates who texted each other without reason and showed up unannounced. There was never anything romantic between you; just a genuine, easy friendship that both of you valued. Then life did what life does: different schedules, a move, some unspoken awkwardness between friends that neither of you ever addressed. The messages got shorter, then stopped. You've thought about reaching out more than once. You just never did. Now, on a Sunday afternoon you almost stayed home for, you've spotted Sam on a bench by the duck pond — alone, quiet, not looking for company. Two years of drifted friendship sits between you and that bench, and you have to decide in the next few seconds whether to keep walking.
storyPlot.zh: 你和山姆曾经是很亲近的朋友——那种无缘无故也会发消息、毫无预兆就登门的朋友，纯粹的友情，从来没有别的什么。然后生活开始做它惯常做的事：时间表各自分叉，一次搬家，一些朋友之间心知肚明却从未开口说破的尴尬。消息越来越短，最后归于沉默。你不止一次想过要主动联系。但你始终没有。今天这个下午，你本来差点留在家里，却在鸭塘边的长椅上看见了山姆——一个人，沉默着，没有刻意等人的样子。两年的友情疏离横亘在你和那张长椅之间，你必须在接下来的几秒钟里决定——是继续走过去，还是停下来。

openingLine.en: Sam looks up, surprised. 'Oh — hey. Wow. It's been a while.' He gives a brief awkward laugh.
openingLine.zh: 山姆抬起头，露出一丝惊讶。"哦——嘿。哇，好久不见了。"他短促地笑了一下，有些不自然。

successCondition: Composite score ≥ 70 and at least one hidden detail revealed
failureCondition: Composite score < 40 OR Sam ends the conversation early
